description.de: Spring Boot Backend Maven Build — blockiert Release bei Build-Fehlern
description.en: Spring Boot backend Maven build — blocks release on build failures

config.label: Maven Build ausführen
config.command:
cd /home/flo/Entwicklung/IdeaProjects/treasure_hunt_backend

echo '=== Maven clean package ==='
mvn clean package -q -DskipTests 2>&1
MVN_EXIT=$?

echo ''
echo '--- Backend Build Gate Summary ---'
echo "Maven exit code: $MVN_EXIT"

if [ $MVN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "gate_status: RED"
  echo "gate_category: backend-build"
  echo "gate_description: Maven Build fehlgeschlagen — Release blockiert"
  exit 1
else
  echo "gate_status: GREEN"
  echo "gate_category: backend-build"
  echo "gate_description: Backend Build erfolgreich"
fi
